title: TV Room
what: A scene dubbed into three languages on one PC: voices separated from the background, lines translated, and each line spoken again by a copy of its own speaker's voice, fitted to its slot.

inputs.label: Scene
inputs.value: chapter one of the bedtime story, 36 s, four voices

inputs.label: Translation
inputs.value: NLLB-200 (600M), sentence by sentence, on this PC

inputs.label: Voices
inputs.value: each line cloned from its own speaker in the original (per line)

inputs.label: Timing
inputs.value: every line fitted to its original slot (strict slot)

snippet:
import requests
API = "http://127.0.0.1:3900"
job = requests.post(f"{API}/dub/upload", data={"source_lang": "en"},
    files={"video": open("scene.mp4", "rb")}).json()["job_id"]
segs = requests.post(f"{API}/dub/transcribe/{job}").json()["segments"]
es = requests.post(f"{API}/dub/translate", json={"segments": segs,
    "target_lang": "es", "provider": "nllb"}).json()["translated"]
requests.post(f"{API}/dub/generate/{job}", json={"segments": es,
    "language": "Spanish", "voice_match": "per_line"})
checks: Every line fits its original slot
Spanish: the dub says the translated lines (98% alike, by Whisper)
French: the dub says the translated lines (98% alike, by Whisper)
Japanese: the dub says the translated lines (87% alike, by Whisper)
